name: Immersive Artistic
description: Magnetic custom cursors, tilt layouts, custom smooth scroll. Perfect for ultra-luxury or cinematic sites.

name: Minimalist Native
description: Subtle, unpretentious hover fades and native scrolling. Stays clean and fast.

name: Reactive Kinetic
description: Custom cursor dots that expand on links, kinetic click ripples, borders that light up. Highly functional and technological.

name: Gesture Physical
description: Highly tactile 3D hover effects, scroll snap points, and spring-based elastic responses.
